items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We used to call him Bad Steve Gadd. Because he had this lick with the hi-hat that was like impossible.

ctx.x: We used to call him Bad Steve Gadd. Because he had this lick with the hi-hat that was like impossible. I mean it was like 16th, 32nd notes, I mean it was this crazy thing he could do with his left hand on the hi-hat. Bad Steve Gadd. I’m sure he’s still bad too.
Well I want to tell you I’ve really enjoyed this conversation.
